GST Taxpayer Constitution and Gender Profile (as of March 2025)

Source: R/data.R
gst_taxpayer_profile.Rd

National breakdown of registered GST taxpayers by constitution of business and female representation, as of 31 March 2025.

gst_taxpayer_profile

Format

A data.table with 16 rows and 4 columns:

constitution

character. Business constitution type (e.g. "Proprietorship", "Private Limited Company", "Partnership").

total_taxpayers

numeric. Total registered taxpayers.

female_count

numeric. Taxpayers with at least one female member.

female_pct

numeric. Female representation percentage.

Source

GST Council / GSTN. https://www.gst.gov.in

Examples

data(gst_taxpayer_profile)
gst_taxpayer_profile[order(-total_taxpayers)]
